Short title and commencement

ACT XXIII OF 1992
ACT XXIII OF 1992
POLITICAL PARTIES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Political Parties Act, 1962
(Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th December, 1992)
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received
the assent of the President on the 6th December, 1992 and is hereby published
for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the Political Parties
(Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 8B, Act III of 1962

2. Amendment of section 8B,
Act III of 1962.-----In the Political Parties Act, 1962 (III of 1962), in

at the end, the words "after providing to such member an opportunity of
being heard" shall be added.
